title.en: Bayesian Modelling and Decisions under Uncertainty
title.ar: النمذجة البايزية واتخاذ القرارات في ظل عدم اليقين

tagline: REPLACE: one line under the title: what participants can do after the course
description: Participants build Bayesian models that support decisions and judge models built by others. On synthetic burst records from 140 districts of a fictional water utility, they test priors by simulation, fit and diagnose Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, pool small districts hierarchically, check and compare models by predictive accuracy, and verify code by simulation-based calibration. The last day turns posteriors into a replacement plan by expected utility and prices a proposed leak survey by its value of information.
audience: Specialists. Data scientists who have completed the level 300 core or can show equivalent work: a defended analysis with a validated model or a causal estimate that they can explain.
prerequisites: DS-301 Regression and Generalised Linear Modelling
Fits and interprets generalised linear models in code
Simulates from probability distributions and computes a likelihood

outcomes.text: Implement a Bayesian workflow from prior predictive simulation to sampler diagnosis, given a burst-count model with network length as exposure
outcomes.evidence: a notebook with prior draws, diagnostics and a reason for each prior

outcomes.text: Design a hierarchical model for districts with very unequal data and defend the pooling it implies, given 140 districts, a third with fewer than five recorded bursts
outcomes.evidence: no-, complete- and partial-pooling estimates with a written defence

outcomes.text: Evaluate competing models by posterior predictive checks and approximate leave-one-out cross-validation and choose one for the decision, given three candidate models of the same data
outcomes.evidence: a comparison table with check plots and the reasoning

outcomes.text: Diagnose an error in a model implementation by parameter recovery and simulation-based calibration, given a model with a seeded coding error
outcomes.evidence: calibration plots that locate the error and a corrected model that passes

outcomes.text: Decide a replacement plan by expected utility under the posterior and price further data by its value of information, given costs, a capital budget and an offered acoustic leak survey
outcomes.evidence: a two-page memo with the plan, its expected loss and a verdict on the survey

outcomes.text: Review another analyst's Bayesian analysis for priors, computation, checking and reporting, given an analysis with six planted flaws
outcomes.evidence: a review that finds at least four flaws and ranks them by effect on the decision
